scene.topic_description:
Situation: You are meeting your son's teacher at school because there have been behavior problems. This is the first serious discussion of what has been happening in class or during breaks, and you need to understand the teacher's concerns clearly before deciding what to do next.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Teacher.
Not in this scene: agreeing on a plan at home and school, consequences, follow-up dates, contact methods.
must_say: give your name and your child's class — slot: the class
say why you asked for the meeting — slot: the concern
ask what behavior the teacher has noticed — slot: the behavior
ask when and where it usually happens — slot: the moment or place
answer whether there were similar problems before — slot: the time or situation
ask how serious the problem is at school — slot: the area (lessons, breaks)
ask what may be causing it — slot: the possible cause
confirm you understand the main concern — slot: the concern
must_understand: asks who your child is and which class they are in
says what behavior has been a problem at school
explains when and where it usually happens
asks whether this has happened before or at home
says how serious the issue is and what may be behind it

findings.detail: no partner line of its own is left for p7 (a7 pairs with p6 and p7): a line is said once, in one exchange, with one frame
the line names «раньше», a filler of p5
«genitore» is a word of the stop list («genitore»)

topic.description_target: Discuss your son's behavior problems and ask when, where, and how serious they are, and what may cause them.
topic.description_native: Обсудить проблемы с поведением сына и узнать, когда и где они происходят, насколько они серьёзны и что может их вызывать.

phrases.frame_target: Sono il genitore; mio figlio frequenta ___
phrases.pronunciation_native: соно иль джениторе; мио фильо фрекуэнта ___

partner_lines.text_target: In che classe è suo figlio?
partner_lines.text_native: В каком классе учится ваш сын?

partner_lines.text_target: Durante le lezioni, interrompe spesso gli altri.
partner_lines.text_native: На уроках он часто перебивает других.

partner_lines.text_target: Succede soprattutto durante le lezioni e in corridoio.
partner_lines.text_native: Это происходит главным образом на уроках и в коридоре.

partner_lines.text_target: È abbastanza serio; sì, potrebbe dipendere da un cambiamento recente.
partner_lines.text_native: Проблема довольно серьёзная; да, причиной могут быть недавние перемены.
